Sam (People Ops): Hey managers  dropping a slightly different template folks asked for: includes accessibility accommodations, a mentorship pairing plan, explicit day-7 + day-14 mini-retro, and a 30/60/90 framed as learning milestones. Copy/pasteable.

Vikram: Love the accessibility bit. A lot of candidates ask about that up front.

Sofia: Can we have a short checklist for remote white-glove vs onsite?

Sam (People Ops): Yup added a tiny table-like checklist and a clear owner for each item.

Greta: Also include a one-line manager checklist for psychological safety (1 thing to say on day1).

Sam (People Ops): Added a suggested sentence managers can say in 1:1.

OnboardBot: Laptop provisioning queued (ETA 3 business days).

Sam (People Ops): Full single-thread copy below (short lines so managers can skim).

```
PRE-BOARD (week before) - ~20m
- Send welcome note with start logistics, buddy, and accommodation ask: "Do you need any accessibility accommodations for your setup or meetings?"
- Open access ticket: Okta, Slack, GitHub, Drive, cloud role, badge if onsite
- Book mentor pairing: 4-week mentorship check-ins (30 min/week) and peer reviewer for first PR
- Reserve white-glove IT slot if remote (drop details to @it-support)

DAY 1 (keep <=4 meetings)
09:30-10:15 Manager 1:1: role context, 90-day learning milestones, immediate priorities; manager says: "My door is open for questions; no question is too small."
11:00-11:30 Team intro: 1-2 min intros + org map (record link) - call out where to find async help
14:00-14:30 Buddy session: env, run-first-app, first PR pairing, show team norms doc
16:30-16:45 Manager pulse: confirm access + accommodations, schedule mentor kickoff

DAYS 2-7
- 15min daily sync (live or async depending on timezone)
- Mentor week1 kickoff: 30min (intro, expectations, learning plan)
- Schedule 2 domain deep dives (product + infra) in week1

DAY 7 MANAGER SIGNOFF (3 bullets)
- New hire opened or merged first PR (buddy confirms)
- Mentor and buddy confirm core env & accommodations are satisfied
- Manager delivered 30-day feedback checkpoint + assigned a small ownership task

DAY 14 MINI-RETRO (15min)
- Quick manager + new hire: whatwent well, whatblocked you, any unmet access or accomodation needs
- Action owner assigned for any remaining blockers

ACCESS & ESCALATION (if stuck)
- Okta/Slack: DM @it-support (label: "onboarding-access {name}")
- GitHub/org invites: DM @dev-platform -> escalate to @it-support after 24h
- Cloud roles: DM @infra-ops and open ticket if cross-team
- If blocked >24h: CC People Ops (Sam) so we can white-glove it

REMOTE VS ONSITE QUICK CHECK
- Remote white-glove: book a 60min screenshare with IT (VPN + image + package install) - owner: @it-support
- Onsite: badge queued, desk reserved - owner: Facilities
- Accessibility setup: request ergonomic gear or software via People Ops (Sam)

WHO OWNS WHAT (one line each)
- Manager: outcomes, roadmap context, psychological safety + 30/60/90 alignment
- Buddy: dev loop, repo norms, first PR pairing, quick answers
- Mentor: learning roadmap, weekly check-ins, 2-week retro
- People Ops: laptop/order, benefits, access escalation coordinator

30/60/90 (framed as learning milestones)
- 30d (observe & contribute): learn system boundaries; complete first small fix; 3 cross-team intros; mentor review 1
- 60d (own & stabilize): own a small feature or bug end-to-end; own incident postmortem readout; mentor review 2
- 90d (lead & improve): lead a cross-team deliverable; propose 1 measurable improvement (perf/cost/quality); mentor review 3 + feedback meeting

SAMPLE SENTENCES / TEMPLATES
Manager 1:1 opener: "Welcome again - my role this week is to make sure you have context and you aren't blocked. Tell me what you need to get to productive. We'll revisit priorities in 30 days."

Slack intro snippet: "Welcome {name} to Team X as {role}! Buddy: {buddy}. Mentor: {mentor}. Fun fact: {one-liner} :tada:"

ACCESS COMMANDS & QUICK HINTS
- Mac dev bootstrap: `curl -sSL https://redwood.tools/bootstrap | sh` (VPN first)
- Linux: `./scripts/bootstrap-dev && ./scripts/run-local`
- If Docker fails: try `docker system prune --volumes` then re-run

NOTES
- Record team intro for multi-timezone hires and offer async standup option
- Explicitly ask new hires about accessibility needs during pre-board and day1
- Day14 retro helps catch process gaps before they become habits
```

Vikram: This is gold. The mentor bit should help retention.

Sofia: Will use for my remote hire next month. Thanks SAM. :heart:

Greta: Small tweak: change day1 manager opener to include timezone-friendly phrasing for global teams.

Sam (People Ops): Noted will add: "If you're in a different timezone we can move this slot - record + async available."
